facts.fact: The health ministry (MINSABSIS) states that the DHIS2 pilot was run during June 2025 in two health districts, Baney (Región Insular) and Añisok (Región Continental), with 104 health professionals trained; no count of facilities is given.

The Ministerio de Sanidad, Bienestar Social e Infraestructuras Sanitarias itself announces the conclusion and systematisation of the DHIS2 pilot and presents the platform as its tool for the national health system.

The ministry states the pilot ran under a primary-care agreement financed by the Spanish cooperation agency AECID, with technical support from the Fundación Religiosa para la Salud; no domestic funding is mentioned.
On 25 November 2025 the ministry declared the DHIS2 pilot in Baney and Añisok successfully completed and said it would be the reference for a national expansion of DHIS2 foreseen for 2026.
